value.text: Architecture redesigned: devices own their own DB watchers (PostgreSQL LISTEN/NOTIFY) — subscription = creating the watcher, not the bus routing messages. The bus becomes a message store, not a router. list/toggle still needed but the mechanism changes: list reads who has active watchers, toggle is the circuit breaker (each device gets one on its settings panel; cairn's settings has breakers for everybody). Message processing = command processing via the same recursive router pattern as the CLI.
